meta.name: SudoCut Brand Tokens
authorityOrder: sudocut/web shipped Round 6 — the visual system of record (design/mockups/shared/bauhaus.css).
brand/reference/option-h-exploration-2026-07.pdf — an exploration. Contributes ideas, not values.

originLegend.web-shipped: Verbatim from sudocut/web. Cited to file and line.
originLegend.option-h: Survives from the Option H PDF exploration because it conflicts with nothing above it.
originLegend.derived: Computed from another token. Derivation shown.

meta.rule: Nothing outside this directory may declare a color, typeface, spacing, radius, shadow or easing literal.

ink.note: Slate-black. Type, rules, footage. Supersedes Option H #111111.

paper.note: Warm off-white default surface. soul.md demands warmth, 'not a sterile text dump'. Supersedes Option H #F5F5F2, which is cooler.

shadowGrey.note: Soft structural grey. NOT a drop shadow — see shadow tokens.

line.note: Hairline dividers and the 76px grid texture.

accent.note: COBALT. The one point color. Supersedes Option H #0D57F2.

accentInk.note: Text on cobalt. Recomputed at runtime from accent luminance in bauhaus.js — keep that guard.

signalRed.note: STATUS ONLY — error/destructive. Never decoration, never a second brand accent. Supersedes Option H 'Cut Red' #F5342A and demotes it from accent to status.

primaryShadow.note: Pure black. Every recommended action gets a hard offset in this color.

rail.note: Deliberately non-competitive greyscale rail. Rest state.

content.note: Body type and rules. ~28% of any view.

action.note: THE one required action. soul.md: 'One point of color marks the required action; everything else stays monochrome.' At most ONE per viewport.

hover.note: Derive tints with color-mix against existing tokens. Never hand-pick a new hex.

suit.note: Carries Hangul. This is the face that makes soul.md's Korean-first mandate possible.

mono.note: System stack. IBM Plex Mono is NOT part of this brand — it cannot set Hangul.

heavy.note: DISPLAY role. HONEST CAVEAT: bauhaus.css:77 statically sets --heavy to Jost; Hahmlet is applied at runtime by the Font Lab via the data-default-display attribute on the SELECTED variant, so the selected default was never frozen into CSS. Q-DISPLAY-FACE RESOLVED 2026-07-26: freeze Hahmlet — it matches the selected Round 6 direction AND sets Hangul, so Korean and Latin headlines share one face. Jost display would force a face swap mid-headline on a Korean-first site. Change this one value to reverse.

body.note: UI + Korean role. Both CSS and runtime agree on SUIT.

numbers.note: Numerals role. Use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for data.

weights.note: Non-round variable weights are the house voice. Base body weight is 450. Do not round these to 400/700.

radius.note: Bauhaus-strict. No rounded corners except 50% circles. Option H's misuse rules independently agree. Q-RADIUS RESOLVED 2026-07-26: 0 governs the company site too — the square corner is the brand signature, and the ranking catalog's 14px was an internal-tool convenience never reviewed as a brand decision. Change this one value to reverse.

edgeBar.note: Colored top-edge bar on panels; 9px on modals.

law.note: ALWAYS hard offset. ZERO blur, ZERO spread. This is the brand signature. Option H said 'no shadows' — that is wrong for this brand; the correct rule is NO BLURRED shadows.

lift.note: Hover lift paired with the shadow growth.

range.note: All functional transitions. Supersedes Option H's 400ms, which is too slow for UI.

principle.value: Transitions between scenes are hard cuts. The brand never dissolves.
principle.note: Survives — the principle is consistent with the shipped fast/functional motion. Only Option H's 400ms NUMBER is superseded.

reducedMotion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

grid.value: linear-gradient(var(--sc-line) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--sc-line) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 76px 76px
grid.note: This plus the warm paper color is HOW soul.md's 양피지 warmth is actually implemented. There is no raster paper texture in the shipped system. See Q-PARCHMENT.

gridSize.note: The pitch of the hairline grid. Emitted as --sc-grid-size so surfaces can draw the texture without restating the number.

unit.note: Geometry survives intact — it conflicts with nothing and sudocut/web has no mark at all.

minSize.note: Below 16px the accent line thickens to 2px minimum so the cut stays visible.

barColor.note: Recolored from Option H's #111111 to the shipped ink.

lineColor.note: Recolored from Option H's #0D57F2 to shipped cobalt.
